IDENTITY_BINDING_CONFLICT.en: The evidence does not all point to the same company.
IDENTITY_BINDING_CONFLICT.zh: 这些证据并非全部指向同一家公司。

RIGHTS_NOT_A_SOURCE.en: This source cannot be used for this product fact.
RIGHTS_NOT_A_SOURCE.zh: 这个来源不能用于这项产品事实。

RIGHTS_INTERNAL_ONLY.en: We can use this source internally, but cannot show this fact.
RIGHTS_INTERNAL_ONLY.zh: 这个来源只能内部使用，不能向你展示这条事实。

SOURCE_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE.en: We could not access this source when this view was built.
SOURCE_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE.zh: 构建此视图时，我们无法访问该来源。

CONFLICTING_SOURCE_SPANS.en: Two copies of this source disagree about which period they cover, so we do not show either.
CONFLICTING_SOURCE_SPANS.zh: 这个来源的两份内容对所覆盖的时间段不一致，因此我们不展示其中任何一份。

CONFLICTING_SOURCE_CLOCKS.en: The source versions disagree about which version came first.
CONFLICTING_SOURCE_CLOCKS.zh: 来源版本对先后顺序存在冲突。

NOT_PUBLISHED_AT_DECISION.en: This information was not yet public at the decision time.
NOT_PUBLISHED_AT_DECISION.zh: 这条信息在决策时还没有公开。

NOT_CAPTURED_AT_DECISION.en: This information was published before the decision, but we did not capture it until later.
NOT_CAPTURED_AT_DECISION.zh: 这条信息在决策前已经发布，但我们直到稍后才取得它。

HISTORICAL_EVENT_SET_UNAVAILABLE.en: We cannot reconstruct the full event list that existed at that time.
HISTORICAL_EVENT_SET_UNAVAILABLE.zh: 我们无法重建当时存在的完整事件列表。

EXACT_LINEAGE_UNAVAILABLE.en: The source exists, but we cannot point to the exact field used.
EXACT_LINEAGE_UNAVAILABLE.zh: 来源存在，但我们无法指出所用的确切字段。

UNKNOWN.en: The available evidence does not establish a usable fact for this view.
UNKNOWN.zh: 现有证据不足以为此视图确定可用事实。

CORRECTED_LATER.en: A later version changed this information after the original decision.
CORRECTED_LATER.zh: 在原始决策之后，新版本更改了这条信息。

IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED.en: We cannot establish which company this evidence belongs to.
IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED.zh: 我们无法确定这项证据属于哪家公司。

RIGHTS_UNDETERMINED.en: Permission to use or show this source has not been established.
RIGHTS_UNDETERMINED.zh: 使用或展示该来源的权限尚未确定。

SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.en: This source is unavailable for this view.
SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.zh: 此视图没有可用的该来源信息。

NOT_AVAILABLE_AT_DECISION.en: This information was not available to this view at the decision time.
NOT_AVAILABLE_AT_DECISION.zh: 在决策时，这项信息尚未可供此视图使用。

STALE.en: This evidence is too old for this view.
STALE.zh: 这项证据对这个视图而言已过时。

NOT_APPLICABLE.en: This evidence does not apply to this view.
NOT_APPLICABLE.zh: 这项证据不适用于此视图。
